stem:
Meena places a bar magnet on one side of a thin glass sheet and a steel paper clip on the other side, close to the sheet but not touching the magnet.
What will happen to the paper clip?

options.text: It will not move, because the glass sheet blocks the magnetic effect.
It will move towards the magnet, because the magnetic effect passes through the glass sheet.
It will move only if the magnet first touches the glass sheet.
It will not move, because paper clips are never attracted to magnets.

teacher.key_rationale: Glass is a non-magnetic sheet and does not block the magnetic effect, so the steel paper clip moves toward the magnet across the gap; A is the trap for learners who assume any sheet between blocks the pull.
